prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1064; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents with damage concentrated on the rear quarter panel and bumper cover, with the impact area consistent with the reported parking lot collision. The paint transfer and crush depth match the account given. Parts and labor are itemized on the attached estimate, and the labor hours for the planned repair run slightly above what I would expect for this scope, so I have flagged that line for review. Our records show no prior damage to this vehicle. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, refinishing the quarter panel, and recalibrating the rear sensors before release.
